datasheet.measures: medium temperature in liquids and gases
datasheet.source: ifm datasheet TA2105-00 (13.04.2023): measuring range -50...150 C, factory setting -50...150 C (no separate setting range given, so measuring range is used); Pt1000, analog 4...20 mA and IO-Link 1.1; DeviceID 377; probe 6 mm, body diameter 18.7 mm, length 88.9 mm. Setting ranges from IODD ifm-000179-20200114-IODD1.1.xml: ASP2 -50.0–145.0 °C, AEP2 -45.0–150.0 °C.
